# `aitbc agent workflow execute`

Execute a previously created workflow with the given input file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent workflow execute [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--workflow-id` | text | — | yes | Workflow ID |
| `--input-file` | path | — | no | JSON file with input parameters |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent workflow execute --workflow-id <workflow_id>
```
